detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Venture into "The Great Fairy Island" to encounter the Xer's in their plot to capture powerful Fairy-type Dokimon and use their powers for evil.

This DLC adds the following content to the base game Dokimon: Quest:

  • Short 3-5 hour side story on "The Great Fairy Island"

  • Grants access to two unlockable vehicle types: Hovercraft, Submarine

  • Adds new routes and an island with Mythic Monster overworld encounters

  • Introduces the "underwater biome" where treasures and rare water types can be discovered

  • Adds a new shrine to "Gad'riel's Peak" with some new and familiar faces

*Adds new Characters. Adds new Overworld Encounters and Cutscenes. Adds new Items. Adds new Routes and Towns. Adds Vehicles. Adds new Dialogue and Interactions. Does not add new Monsters.
